This neuron is essentially a negative/suppression unit: its largest-magnitude responses are strong negative activations on the temporal adverb "then" meaning "at that time" (e.g., "the then head", "was then undergoing") and on "time" in "at the time of"; its (near-zero) "max" side fires weakly and unspecifically on assorted mid-phrase tokens like a year digit, " over", " reply", " time".
